message:
Now I understand the fuzz input format. The input starts with:
- 4 bytes: opts
- 4 bytes: failurePos
- 4 bytes: maxChunkSize
- Then entities (via `xmlFuzzReadEntities`)

Let me look at `fuzz.c` to understand `xmlFuzzReadEntities` and `xmlFuzzMainEntity` to understand the exact input format.

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜=command>grep -n "xmlFuzzReadEntities\|xmlFuzzMainEntity\|xmlFuzzReadString\|xmlFuzzReadInt" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/fuzz/fuzz.c | head -30</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
